## Environment

Skill version/tag, Linux distribution, Python/Git versions and OpenClaw version:

## Reproduction

Provide minimal commands and **synthetic** input that reproduce the issue.
Never attach real project records, credentials, private hostnames or personal data.

## Expected and actual behavior

Include the failing check and redacted error text. State whether any canonical
record changed despite a rejected operation.

For vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md instead of posting exploitable details here.
